info.background_text:
Genius swordswoman dreaming of love.
Wanders in search of "the one and only destined love in the universe." Her goal is to become an ordinary bride. She believes her swordsmanship and strength make her far from "ordinary" and thinks it doesn't make her look cute, thus planning to hide it from her destined other.
